reviews.comment: He goes all out before exams: extra office hours, lectures for the sole purpose of summing up the exam material, and an exam review. The exam reviews also have two questions that reappear on their respective exams, so take advantage! He's very friendly as well.
cool teacher. very friendly, accessible via office hours, always happy to help. keep up with the homeworks (dont chatgpt it) and do good on the quizzes, and you will be fine.

I loved taking this class with Dr. Fillman—he's a funny guy who genuinely loves teaching math. I enjoyed going to class, but I'll admit this course is conceptually difficult. Take advantage of office hours and attend every class! The class was 70% exams, 15% homework, and 15% recitation, so start studying early for exams!

Great professor who's really good at explaining conceptual things and relating them back to Calculus I ideas. He solves a lot of examples and draws a lot of pictures on the board so it's easy to understand what's going on. He's very accessible outside of class, has helpful office hours, and gives extra credit. Definitely take his class!

Gives 4% ec on hw if done early. Explains concepts well in class and OH, but does get extra conceptual on quizzes/finals than in class, requiring you to actually understand why we are doing this math. Midterms/finals worth 70% of grade, but gives 1 ec question (usually super hard). Practice exams are representative of exam but don't have answers.

He's a funny and good professor that works through topics and problems clearly. He usually compares topics to their 2D counterpart and works through derivations to help show where things come from and why things are the way they are. Overall, he's a good professor to get.

Dr. Fillman is as best as they come. He is extremely humble and truly cares about teaching his students. He even made an effort to learn all of our names. The class has two midterms and a final with the final replacing your lowest midterm grade, so just do well on the midterms and then you don't have to stress over the final. Take this class!

Fillman was very engaging. Wrote very fair quizzes and tests, even offering bonus points on them. Homework is department wide, where he had very little control over it but taught course content very well and explained problems very thoroughly. Only thing is that he will not upload his notes, so attend classes and pay attention to lectures!

This professor actually cares about teaching his students how to do calculus III. He is very down to earth and kinda gives me chill Bob Ross vibes if Bob Ross was a mathematician. The structure of each class is first 5 minutes introducing a concept in theory and the next 45 minutes giving nuanced example on its application. Highly recommend.

Great Professor, the course has 2 tests and 1 final with recitation every week. Quizzes are usually the easiest portion of the class followed by tests then HWs. HWs can take a while to do but he does offer extra credit if you finish 24 hours before due date. He always stops during lectures to ask if you have and questions, comments or concerns.
